seed_ledger.reason: Smarr (1425 MW, Monroe County GA): NO_DC_TIE, Oglethorpe says the plant serves system-wide member growth, no data center named for it. Supply is by Southern Natural Gas expansion precedent agreements and a Tennessee Gas Mississippi Crossing agreement, both in service about Nov 2028 per its 10-Q; not staged because no plant tie, though a Smarr tie would make them tag leads. A Google project near the site is not tied to the plant by any source. Searches run: 2. Sources: Oglethorpe 10-Qs via search (SONAT and TGP agreements); power-eng Kiewit item (member growth); GPB on USDA loan (no tie).
